title: Start September with 3 Classes for $59 at Our Pilates Studio in West End Toronto
excerpt: Three classes for $59, good for 30 days and usable on almost anything on the schedule — and the September schedule is live, with a second Prenatal Mat class on Saturdays at 11:30am from week two.

title: Wrapping Up July: Pack Discounts, Sold-Out Workshops, and More Prenatal Classes
excerpt: Our 6:30am reformer classes ran full almost every morning in July and Marco's Breath & Core workshop sold out, so we're adding a second Saturday prenatal class in August. The July Reset pack discount ends July 31.

title: August at Foxglove: Full Classes, 30-Minute Lunches, and the Final Days of the Reset
excerpt: A look back at a busy August on Wrenfield Ave — a sold-out workshop, a lunch class built around walking distance, and the last few days to use RESET20 on a 10-class pack.
